sentences.text: Ryan McInerney, 49, became CEO of Visa Inc. in 2023, having joined the company in 2013 and previously serving as President of Visa's global businesses.
Before Visa, he was CEO of consumer banking at JPMorgan Chase and, earlier, a principal at McKinsey in the firm's retail banking and payments practices.
His profile reflects the most consistent thread in Visa's executive ranks, major financial institutions and strategy consulting, and makes him a long-tenured, deeply domain-specialized leader.
